response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack engineer (13+ years) with strong TypeScript/Node.js background, direct current experience with AI-agent infrastructure (MCP, agentic frameworks) which is a key requirement, and broad exposure to multiple languages, databases, and containerization. While explicit Nest.js and Vitest experience are not called out, his deep engineering craftsmanship, testing tooling background (built test runners/assertion libraries), and diverse stack adaptability make him a strong candidate worth interviewing.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience (13+ years) exceeding seniority requirements, spanning frontend, backend, mobile, and infrastructure
Current hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks, directly matching a required skill
Strong testing/craftsmanship culture (TDD, built custom test runners and assertion libraries) and Git/CI/CD fluency
concerns: No explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest, both core to the primary stack
React experience appears limited (mostly Ember.js), despite React being a primary frontend requirement
Cloud platform and Kubernetes/container orchestration experience is only lightly referenced, not deeply demonstrated
